description: Look up a NUTS statistical region of the European Union: resolve a NUTS code to its name, country and level, walk up to its parents or down to its children, or search regions by name. Covers all four levels (country, major region, basic region, small region) for the 27 member states and 12 further reporting countries, from the NUTS 2024 classification. Returns the Latin-script and local-language names plus the urbanisation, coastal and mountain typologies. Price: $0.05 per successful call, paid over x402 (USDC on Base).

code.description: NUTS code, 2-5 characters, case-insensitive (level-3 codes may contain letters, e.g. NL32B). A GR or GB prefix is accepted for EL or UK. Accepted: 2 to 5 characters matching ^[A-Z]{2}[0-9A-Z]{0,3}$.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country filter (UK/GB and EL/GR both accepted). Accepted: an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code.

include.description: Comma-separated: parents, children, typology. Default parents,typology. Accepted: comma-separated subset of parents, children, typology.

level.description: Restrict a name search to one level, 0-3. Accepted: integer 0-3.

name.description: Substring search on region names, case- and accent-insensitive. Up to 25 matches. Accepted: at most 128 characters.

name: ref_nuts
title: NUTS statistical region code lookup for the EU
